name: Eleazar
description: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar are taken from among the children of Israel to minister unto the Most High in the priest's office.

note.label: Exodus 28: Holy Garments for Glory and for Beauty

points: Aaron, Eleazar, and Ithamar were told, uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes, lest ye die and wrath come upon all the people; basically they were told not to mourn for them, because Nadab and Abihu died in the midst of sin and what they did was abominable to the Most High. The whole house of Israel would bewail the burning which the Lord kindled.

note.label: Leviticus 10: Strange Fire and the Charge of the Priesthood

points: Moses told Aaron, Eleazar, and Ithamar to take the meat offering that remained of the offerings made by fire and eat it without leaven beside the altar, in the holy place, for it was their due; and the wave breast and heave shoulder were eaten in a clean place, the due of Aaron and his sons and his daughters by a statute for ever.

note.label: Leviticus 10: Strange Fire and the Charge of the Priesthood

points: Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it was burnt; and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, because the Most High had given it to them to bear the iniquity of the congregation, and seeing the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place, they should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as he commanded.

note.label: Leviticus 10: Strange Fire and the Charge of the Priesthood

points: Eleazar the son of Aaron was chief over the chief of the Levites, with the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary. He was the manager of the tabernacle.

note.label: Numbers 3: The Levites Taken Instead of the Firstborn

points: To the office of Eleazar pertained the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the daily meat offering, the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle. The burning of the sweet incense stayed in that priestly line: Zacharias, of the course of Abia, descended from the line of the Kohathites, and his lot was to burn incense in the temple of the Lord.

note.label: Numbers 4: The Service of the Tabernacle Done in Order

points: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them upon Eleazar his son; the priesthood passed to Eleazar, and Aaron died there in the top of the mount.

note.label: Numbers 20: Strife at Meribah and Edom's Refusal

points: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, rose up from among the congregation, took a javelin in his hand, and thrust both of them through. And those that died in the plague were 24,000. In one day God killed 24,000, because of sin.

note.label: Why They Hated US: Walking in the Footsteps of the Persecuted

points: When Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, took a javelin in his hand, went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through; so the plague was stayed from the children of Israel, and those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

note.label: Numbers 25: Baal-peor and the Zeal of Phinehas

points: The daughters of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh, stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the princes, and all the congregation at the door of the tabernacle.

note.label: Numbers 27: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Ordination of Joshua

points: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight. Some of you brothers have been given the same charge as leaders, as heads of offices, as parts and helps in various offices. That has been done before the sight of the entire office, the entire congregation, the entire nation. You have been given those parameters of your offices in the sight of everybody.

note.label: Stay in the Spirit

points: Joshua was set before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation and given his charge in their sight, and some of Moses' honour was put upon him, so all Israel could see with their own eyes the man the Most High ordained to lead the nation after the death of Moses.

note.label: Numbers 27: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Ordination of Joshua

points: Joshua was to stand before Eleazar the priest, who would ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord; at his word they would go out and come in, he and all the children of Israel with him.

note.label: Numbers 27: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Ordination of Joshua

points: Moses did as the Lord commanded him: he took Joshua, set him before Eleazar the priest and all the congregation, laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

note.label: Numbers 27: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Ordination of Joshua

points: A thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war, were sent with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the holy instruments and the trumpets to blow.

note.label: Numbers 31: Vengeance on the Midianites

points: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation took the sum of the prey, both of man and of beast, adding up all that was taken from the Midianites.

note.label: Numbers 31: Vengeance on the Midianites

points: Moses gave the tribute, the Lord's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses. The heave offerings belong to the priesthood by statute forever, a covenant of salt, because Aaron and Levi have no inheritance in the land; the Most High is their part and their inheritance.

note.label: Numbers 31: Vengeance on the Midianites

points: The Lord named the men which shall divide the land: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun, and one prince of every tribe, Caleb the son of Jephunneh for Judah and the rest by name.

note.label: Numbers 34: The Borders of the Land of Canaan

points: Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.

note.label: Deuteronomy 10: What Doth the Lord Require of Thee

points: The countries in the land of Canaan were distributed by Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes, by lot, as the Most High commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes and the half tribe; Moses had already given the two tribes and a half their inheritance on the other side Jordan.

note.label: Joshua 14: Caleb Wholly Followed the Most High

points: They came near before Eleazar the priest, before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying the Lord commanded Moses to give them an inheritance among their brethren; and according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

note.label: Joshua 17: The Lot of Manasseh and the Blessing of Ephraim

points: Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes divided the inheritances by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country; everybody had their portion, and everyone was satisfied.

note.label: Joshua 19: The Portions of the Remaining Tribes

points: The heads of the fathers of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua, and to the heads of the tribes at Shiloh, because the tribe of Levi had been appointed cities to dwell in with suburbs for their cattle, and the time had come to receive them.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: Israel sent Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest with ten princes, one head of a chief house from every tribe. When you send Phinehas it is a problem, because of the kind of man Phinehas was: where he showed up, the zeal of the Most High showed up with him.

note.label: Joshua 22: The Altar of Witness

points: Eleazar the son of Aaron died, and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

note.label: Joshua 24: Choose You This Day Whom Ye Will Serve

points: The ark of the covenant of God was there in those days, and Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it. They asked, shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand: a direct promise of victory on the morrow.

note.label: Judges 20: Israel's War Against Benjamin

points: The sons of Aaron are named from Eleazar down to Ahimaaz, the high priestly line.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: These are the divisions of the sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children, so Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office. David distributed them according to their offices in their service.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar, sixteen of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar. They were divided by lot, one sort with another, and Shemaiah the scribe wrote them before the king and the princes, taking record for each.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: Ezra's genealogy is traced back through Zadok and Phinehas to Eleazar the son of Aaron the chief priest, marking him a priest of the true line.

note.label: Ezra 7: Ezra The Ready Scribe Prepares His Heart
